简自豪地照看著年幼的弟妹，而她的父母则和朋友们在外享受了一晚的欢聚。

Jane was proudly babysitting her younger siblings while her parents enjoyed a night out with friends.
简自豪地照看著年幼的弟妹，而她的父母则和朋友们在外享受了一晚的欢聚。

segments.body:
Before she retired to bed for the night, Jane wrote her parents a note to fill them in on the events of the evening.
在入睡前，简给父母留了一张便条，向他们汇报当晚的情况。

Before she retired to bed for the night, Jane wrote her parents a note to fill them in on the events of the evening.
在入睡前，简给父母留了一张便条，向他们汇报当晚的情况。

segments.body:
Dear Mum and Dad, I am just about to go to bed and the time is nine.
亲爱的爸爸妈妈，我正准备上床睡觉，现在是九点。
segments.text:

segments.body:
I have put Grant's nappy on, so there is no need to worry about him wetting on the sheet.

segments.body:

segments.body:
